knowledge.title: LE severe error – run-time termination (often caused by I/O or data error)
causes: File opened without FILE STATUS and a bad status occurred (LE terminates the run)
An IGZ0035S message just before this abend names the file and status code
COBOL STOP RUN after detecting an error and calling CEEMRCE
look_at: IGZ0035S or IGZ0037S messages in SYSOUT
FILE STATUS clause on all SELECT statements
the step that precedes the U4038 in the spool

file_status_meaning.35: File not present at OPEN – dataset does not exist; check DSN= in the DD

message_meaning.IEF450I: Step abended – line identifies step name and abend code (system or user).
message_meaning.IGZ0035S: File opened without FILE STATUS and got a non-zero status. Add FILE STATUS to the SELECT or fix the underlying problem (status code is in the message).
